message: `panic` may panic here, and a module of this package, held to no panic by default (`--allow-panics` relaxes the modules `noPanic` does not list), may keep no panic site but out of memory: `panic` stops the program, and no proof removes a call to it: return a `Result` and let the caller decide

`window` may panic here, and a module of this package, held to no panic by default (`--allow-panics` relaxes the modules `noPanic` does not list), may keep no panic site but out of memory: `checkWindow` panics when `[off, off + len)` is outside `buf`, and nothing proves it inside here: pass `0` and a count no larger than `buf.length`, or a count written `end - off` behind a guard — `if (off >= 0 && off <= end && end <= buf.length)` proves it
